assessments.decision: Do not create a standalone repository. Reuse the canonical event envelope and economic record schema, then add a versioned Offer/Quote contract under synergy_system. No offer-specific contract with seller, validity, quantity, price components, terms, jurisdiction, expiry and provenance was found in the inspected schemas.

Do not create a separate pricing engine yet. MarketGraph models conversion rates, fees, slippage and indicative fair value; the economic schema defines typed money and provenance. Neither is a general commercial pricing policy or dynamic price optimizer. First define a quote/price contract and test objective functions in the owning marketplace domain.

Do not create a competing transaction authority. META API workflow is bounded and local/read-only; Pay System owns payment route and settlement logic, while Financial OS owns accounting recognition. A durable multi-party order saga, compensation model, idempotent state machine and marketplace fulfilment contract were not established. Define these in the owning commercial domain and connect to payment/accounting authorities through events.

A commercial skills marketplace is not implemented by the inspected tool catalog: META API can preview/register OpenAPI tools in an in-memory, non-tenant-isolated catalog and fetch public MCP metadata, but it does not manage skill packages, versions, licensing, seller identity, reviews, payments or royalties. Keep as a distinct product proposal, but defer repository creation until the Agent Skills artifact/manifest and trust/licensing contracts are defined.

No tutor matching, lesson runtime, student progress, scheduling or education-specific provider integration was found. The 500-app catalog is a product-design inventory and App Family is a documentation-only stub, not an education platform. Treat tutoring as part of one future education vertical rather than creating a standalone repository before scope and safeguards are specified.

No course catalog, instructor/course lifecycle, enrolment, assessment, certificate or learning-progress runtime was found. The application catalog includes education as a proposed app category only. Combine courses and tutoring under one education domain/product boundary and defer separate repositories until a concrete course schema and delivery model exist.

Generic OpenAPI/MCP discovery can be reused, but no video-specific provider adapters, job lifecycle, media input/output contract, rights/licensing checks, quality evaluation or cost/latency routing were found. Keep the vertical distinct; defer a repository until at least two providers and a reproducible job/quote contract exist.

The inspected Lead OS discovers and reviews leads and can explicitly dispatch approved records to CRM; it is not an ad campaign router. No campaign budgets, creatives, audience targeting, platform adapters, attribution or campaign reconciliation were found in the reviewed main-branch evidence. Keep distinct from lead discovery and defer until ad-platform connectors and consent/attribution contracts are specified.

The Search Engine repository is explicitly RESEARCH/SIMULATION around HardNAV, token economics and EVM experiments; Lead OS is local FTS5/VK lead discovery. Neither demonstrates technical SEO crawling, keyword/rank tracking, backlink analysis, site audit or SEO provider comparison. Keep SEO as a distinct future service domain, but require a precise product boundary before creating a repository.

Pay System provides payment quotes, routing and settlement, not a coupon catalogue or redemption engine. No merchant-funded coupon inventory, eligibility rules, expiry/stacking, redemption idempotency, fraud controls or merchant reimbursement flow were found. Keep coupon discovery distinct from payment settlement and cashback; defer creation until merchant and redemption contracts are defined.

Maps provides geospatial visualization, administrative boundaries and a robust geodata ingestion/validation pipeline; it does not provide carrier discovery, freight quotes, shipment state, capacity booking, proof of delivery or logistics settlement. Reuse Maps for geospatial context, not as the logistics router. Defer a vertical repository until carrier APIs and shipment contracts are identified.

Lead OS includes a real-estate/residency lead workflow, human review and lawful-contact gating, but it does not provide a verified lawyer registry, bar/licence validation, jurisdiction-specific legal expertise, engagement workflow, case management or legal advice quality controls. Keep legal services distinct; require jurisdiction, professional credential, conflict-check and human-responsibility contracts before implementation.
